title: Resolve the pager command once, in `_pager_contextmanager`
body:
Following the refactor of #3767, I just noticed an opportunity to deduplicate the `shutil.which` call that appears both in `_pipepager()` and `_tempfilepager()`. These methods are were already a source of a lot of tweaking these past few years so this should make them more readable.

Also used the opportunity to remove unnecessary `if color is None: color = False` lines which made superfluous normalization inside each strategy. The color interpretation is already handled by the new `_PagerWriter`.
author: kdeldycke
